steps.title: Opener
steps.rule: Loose spread around the centre marker while Ifrit lands.

steps.title: Run to the opener safe spot
steps.rule: Ifrit dashes across the arena along his facing. Find the Radiant Plume on the edge beside his dash line and run to the wall on the opposite side of it, out of the dash lane. Two rows: four at the wall, four a step inside.
steps.cue: Crimson Cyclone cast starts and the Radiant Plumes show

steps.title: Ifrit south, party north
steps.rule: Group just north of the centre, between the centre marker and A, melee a step closer. He stays centred so the Radiant Plume knockback has nothing to push you into.
steps.cue: Ifrit lands back in the centre

MainTank.rule: Take Ifrit a few steps south of the centre and face him away from the party.

steps.title: Nails: party by the centre, Ifrit between the close pair
steps.rule: Two nails stand close together, two stand alone. The party gathers at the centre marker, shifted a little toward the lone nails, and spreads loosely.

MainTank.rule: Drag Ifrit out between the two close nails, ten metres from the centre, and face him away from the party.

steps.title: Baiters to the wall
steps.rule: Physical ranged goes to the wall just clockwise of the lone nail across from the close pair; caster goes to the wall just counterclockwise of the other lone nail. Everyone else stays with Ifrit.
steps.cue: Inferno Howl goes out and Infernal Fetters ties two players

PhysRangedDps.rule: Wall, just clockwise of the lone nail that faces the close pair.

CasterDps.rule: Wall, just counterclockwise of the other lone nail.

steps.title: Searing Wind: leave the party
steps.rule: You explode around yourself every few seconds. Run to the wall directly opposite the close pair of nails and stay there until the debuff is gone.
steps.cue: Inferno Howl hits you and Searing Wind appears on your bar

steps.title: Bait Eruption 1
steps.rule: Baiters: step along the wall toward the close pair, a third of a quarter turn, so the puddle drops behind you.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Along the wall toward the close pair, a third of a quarter turn.

CasterDps.rule: Along the wall toward the close pair, a third of a quarter turn.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 2
steps.rule: Baiters: another third of a quarter turn along the wall, toward the close pair.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 3
steps.rule: Baiters: one more step along the wall; you end up a quarter turn from where you started.

steps.title: Baiters return
steps.rule: Baiters walk back to the party at the centre marker.
steps.cue: The last Eruption hits and the first nail dies

steps.title: Searing Wind holder returns
steps.rule: Rejoin the party at the centre marker.

steps.title: Centre for Hellfire
steps.rule: Loose spread around the centre marker; Hellfire is a raidwide, nothing to dodge.
steps.cue: The last nail dies and Ifrit leaves

steps.title: Corner of the close pair
steps.rule: Party gathers at the wall in the corner between the two close nails' old spots, loosely spread. Ifrit lands there and stays tanked at the wall.

MainTank.rule: Same corner, a couple of metres further out than the party, Ifrit facing the wall.

steps.title: Baiters to the far wall
steps.rule: Physical ranged and caster run to the wall a little past the opposite side of the party's corner, side by side.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Wall, slightly clockwise of the point opposite the corner.

CasterDps.rule: Wall, slightly clockwise of the point opposite the corner, next to the physical ranged.

steps.title: Second Searing Wind: leave
steps.rule: You have Searing Wind. Go to the wall a quarter turn counterclockwise from the party's corner and stay away from everyone.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 1
steps.rule: Baiters: a third of a quarter turn along the wall, counterclockwise, away from the corner side you came from.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 2
steps.rule: Baiters: same step again, counterclockwise along the wall.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 3
steps.rule: Baiters: last step; you are now a quarter turn from the opposite point.

steps.title: Baiters back to the corner
steps.rule: Baiters rejoin the party in the corner.

steps.title: Third Searing Wind: leave
steps.rule: You have Searing Wind now. Go to the wall a quarter turn clockwise from the party's corner.

steps.title: Second holder rejoins
steps.rule: Back to the party in the corner.

steps.title: Third holder moves across
steps.rule: Keep Searing Wind away: slide along the wall to the point directly opposite the corner, where Ifrit's clones won't line up on you.

steps.title: Dodge the four Crimson Cyclones
steps.rule: Four clones dash across the arena, one after another, in the order the nails died. The awakened one also leaves a cross behind. Stand off every dash line that hasn't fired yet and keep moving to the next safe strip as each lane clears.
steps.cue: Ifrit vanishes and the clones appear at the nails' spots

steps.title: Ifrit west, party east of him
steps.rule: Party groups a few steps south-west of the centre, loosely spread. Ifrit is tanked at the west wall facing away.
steps.cue: The last dash resolves and Ifrit is back

MainTank.rule: Pull Ifrit to the west wall and face him away from the party.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 1
steps.rule: Baiters go to the south-east wall.

PhysRangedDps.rule: South-east wall, left of the caster.

CasterDps.rule: South-east wall, right of the physical ranged.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 2
steps.rule: Baiters: a third of a quarter turn counterclockwise along the wall, toward east.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 3
steps.rule: Baiters: east wall.

steps.title: Bait Eruption 4
steps.rule: Baiters: north-east wall.

steps.title: Baiters return
steps.rule: Baiters rejoin the party south-west of the centre.
